sources.label: Berachain public RPC observation at block 26483059

reserveReview.rationale: A direct Berachain read at block 26483059 valued all thirteen configured positive Beraborrow collateral-vault balances and normalized them to 100%. The read used the exact token and DenManager addresses in Beraborrow's contract registry and the source keys emitted by the live liquity-v2-branches adapter. Six legacy branches report shutdown or sunset status, but their positive collateral balances remain part of the full outstanding reserve composition. The pumpBTC DefiLlama quote was unavailable, so the same-block branch oracle price was used; the other branch balances and prices were read through the configured on-chain and DefiLlama paths.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: All configured positive Beraborrow collateral-vault balances observed on Berachain block 26483059 on 2026-09-21
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All configured positive branches are identified and weighted. Wrapper custody, validator, LP unwind, oracle, and liquidation-liquidity risks remain explicit structured risk factors rather than unclassified exposure.
